content: Co-existing System with category SYSTEM_DESCRIPTION and System with category SYSTEM_EXTRACT In order to be able to handle one System with category SYSTEM_DESCRIPTION and one or several System s with category SYSTEM_EXTRACT within the same workspace it shall be possible to pro- vide different full qualified names to the elements of System with category SYS- TEM_EXTRACT .
